title: Rosemary Beach "Memories on Water" 325 West Water Street Main and Carriage House
h1: Rosemary Beach "Memories on Water" 325 West Water Street Main and Carriage House
description_expanded: HOME HIGHLIGHTS:- Steps to the white sand beaches and world class Rosemary Beach restaurants- Perfect location – 3 minute walk to the private beach, 3 minute walk to shops and restaurants (relax at home as you await the text that your table is ready!)- Amazing Gulf view balcony - perfect for connecting with family, having a morning coffee or happy-hour cocktail- Large, serene bedrooms – each with full bathroom, king size beds and patios- Designer magazine décor – chef’s kitchen in main house w/high end appliances and furniture, marble countertops, large island, dining table for 8, stunning fireplace, and vaulted beamed ceilings in both houses- Access to a community pool right across the street with both sun and shade reclining- Private parking for two vehicles in the garage, 6 adult bikes, and a private courtyard- Complete Clean Linen Participant - ALL linens, including comforter covers, are laundered upon every checkout**All Bathrooms are undergoing renovation, with completion anticipated in April 2025.**DETAILS: Guests will love Memories on Water, a serene 5-bedroom, 5.5-bathroom Rosemary Beach home, and Carriage House that sleeps 13. South of 30A and mere steps from Rosemary’s famous beach, guests will relish the lush landscaping, a balcony with Gulf views, luxe furnishings, and being steps from neighborhood pools, dining, and shopping. A primary bedroom, bunk room, and guest bedroom on the first floor enjoy quick access to a lush outdoor courtyard with a fire-pit, propane grill, and the peaceful sounds of a fountain. The primary bedroom has a king bed, makeup vanity, and a private bathroom with glistening green glass tiles, large soaking tub with jets, and a glass-enclosed shower with double shower heads. A guest bedroom has a romantic 4-poster king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Younger guests will enjoy the bunk rooms queen-over-queen bunk bed, and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Dramatic exposed ceiling beams on the second floor pull the eye up to the beautiful arched ceilings. An open kitchen, dining, and living space enjoy lots of natural light and open to a balcony with views of Rosemary Beach. A sofa and comfy armchairs surround a dramatic fireplace in a living area dotted with seashells and coastal accents. Premium appliances, marble countertops, and a center island that seats 4 complete a beautiful chef’s kitchen. A dining table seats 8. Tucked behind the kitchen is a guest bedroom with a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. A smaller den gives guests a private area to relax on a wrap-around sofa, play games, or enjoy a movie. The separate Carriage House is an adorable mini version of Memories on Water. Guests will love the lush landscaping at the entrance, the dramatic exposed ceiling beams in the living area, and the tasteful interior coastal accents. Guests have everything they need in the full kitchen and will enjoy welcoming the day from a private balcony. A guest bedroom has a king bed and a private bathroom with a shower/tub combo. Guests can explore all that Rosemary Beach offers on 6 included adult bikes. With a location this close to the beach, Memories on Water will book quickly. SLEEPING ARRANGEMENTS:FIRST FLOOR:Primary Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower and TubGuest Bedroom: Queen over Queen Bunk Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboGuest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboSECOND FLOOR:Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboCARRIAGE HOUSE: Guest Bedroom: King Bed, Private Bathroom with Shower/Tub ComboAdditional Sleeping: Queen Sleeper SofaWeddings are not allowed at this home. If this policy is violated, you may be asked to vacate the property and forfeit any rental payments as well as be subject to HOA, community, and 360 Blue fines.
